summary: Add immediate inbox Read controls and restore refused small actions with a note

replay.detail: Client overlays do not change authoritative replay.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Only served message-read and update-acknowledgement actions are offered.

compatibility.detail: Readable updates follow alert rows without adding needs-you badges. Read sends immediately without confirmation. Read and structured-ask dismissal remove their rows optimistically; a refusal restores the authoritative row with a shared note that survives component remounts.

recovery.detail: Reload discards local overlays and notes; authoritative read and answer state is unchanged.
